reviewMethod: All 15 screenshots inspected with view_image. Starter selection, parameter values, event names, media receipts and source document navigation are legible. Long descriptions use the existing inner scroll area; long Japanese select labels use the existing truncation. Footer actions remain reachable at 390px.
limitations: Native collider navigation has an exact physics source selection. Project-event publisher and subscriber sources carry distinct frozen propertyPath values, but this existing event-origin contract supplies no sourceRange; these actions open the behavior document without an exact text selection.
First browser run retained before the later per-subscriber queued-platform lifecycle hardening. Final source fingerprint verification requires the subsequent browser run.
